title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七: 穆宗下
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七: 穆宗下 Volume 7 Annals 7: Muzong 2

sentences.zh: 穆宗下

translations.literal: Muzong, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Muzong, Part Two

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月戊寅朔，奉安神纛。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first month of spring, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first spring month, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，漢以宋將來襲，馳告。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Han sent urgent word that Song generals were coming to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Han sent an urgent report that Song generals were marching to attack.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，詔西南面招討使撻烈進兵援漢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi day, an edict ordered Southwest Pacification Commissioner Talie to advance troops to aid Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi day, an edict directed Southwest Pacification Commissioner Talie to march in relief of Han.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，如潢河。

translations.literal: On guihai day he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，支解鹿人沒答、海裏等七人於野，封土識其地。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the deer-keepers Moda, Haili, and five others were dismembered in the wild; earth was piled to mark the place.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day seven deer-keepers, including Moda and Haili, were dismembered in the open country, and mounds of earth were raised to mark the spot.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如老林東濼。

translations.literal: On jisi day he went to Old Forest East Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor went to Old Forest East Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬申，漢以敗宋兵石州來告。

translations.literal: On renshen day Han reported defeating Song troops at Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Han reported a victory over Song forces at Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，漢以擊退宋軍，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, Han sent envoys to give thanks for repelling the Song army.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on dingsi day, Han sent envoys to thank the court for driving back the Song army.

sentences.zh: 是月，黃龍府甘露降。

translations.literal: That month sweet dew fell at Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month sweet dew descended at Huanglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月，射舐堿鹿於白鷹山，至於浹旬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he shot salt-licking deer at White Eagle Mountain, continuing for nearly ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he hunted salt-licking deer at White Eagle Mountain for nearly ten days straight.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午朔，獵於玉山，竟月忘返。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, he hunted at Jade Mountain and forgot to return for the whole month.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month he hunted at Jade Mountain and did not return for the entire month.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，以酒脯祀黑山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen day, wine and dried meat were used to sacrifice to Black Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on renchen day, the Emperor sacrificed wine and dried meat to Black Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，如硙子嶺，呼鹿射之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yisi day, he went to Miaozi Ridge and called deer to be shot.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi day, he went to Miaozi Ridge, called up deer, and shot them.

sentences.zh: 獲鹿四，賜虞人女瑰等物有差。

translations.literal: Four deer were taken; the gamekeepers Nügui and others were rewarded with gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Four deer were taken, and the gamekeepers Nügui and others received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 丁未，還宮。

translations.literal: On dingwei day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以生日值天赦，不受賀，曲赦京師囚。

translations.literal: On wushen day his birthday fell on a heaven-sent amnesty; he declined congratulations and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day his birthday coincided with a heaven-sent amnesty; he refused congratulations and granted a partial amnesty to prisoners in the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 九月，黃室韋叛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Yellow Shiwei rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Yellow Shiwei rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，近侍烏古者進石錯，賜白金二百五十兩。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu day, the attendant Wuguzhe presented polished stone and was granted two hundred fifty taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on bingwu day, the attendant Wuguzhe presented polished stone and received two hundred fifty taels of white gold.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以掌鹿矧思代斡裏為閘撒狘，賜金帶、金盞，銀二百兩。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Zhanglu Shensi replaced Wolli as zhassaji and was granted a gold belt, a gold cup, and two hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhanglu Shensi replaced Wolli as zhassaji and was given a gold belt, a gold cup, and two hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 所隸死罪以下得專之。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority over offenses up to and including capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority to punish every offense short of capital crime.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，日南至，宴飲達旦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, at the winter solstice, he feasted and drank until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, at the winter solstice, he feasted and drank until dawn.

sentences.zh: 自是晝寢夜飲。

translations.literal: From then on he slept by day and drank by night.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he slept through the day and drank through the night.

sentences.zh: 殺近侍小六於禁中。

translations.literal: He killed the attendant Xiao Liu within the forbidden palace.
translations.idiomatic: He killed the attendant Xiao Liu inside the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，以黑兔祭神。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, a black rabbit was sacrificed to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, a black rabbit was sacrificed to the spirits.

sentences.zh: 烏古叛，掠民財畜。

translations.literal: The Wugu rebelled and plundered the people's property and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The Wugu rebelled and plundered civilian property and livestock.

sentences.zh: 詳穩僧隱與戰，敗績，僧隱及乙實等死之。

translations.literal: Xiangwen Sengyin fought them and was defeated; Sengyin, Yishi, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangwen Sengyin gave battle and was routed; Sengyin, Yishi, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月乙卯，以樞密使雅裏斯為行軍都統，虎軍詳穩楚思為行軍都監，益以突呂不部軍三百，合諸部兵討之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi was made campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and forces from the various tribes were combined to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day in the first spring month, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and combined forces from the tribes were sent to suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 烏古夷離堇子勃勒底獨不叛，詔褒之。

translations.literal: Ziboleidi, son of the Wugu yilijin, alone did not rebel, and an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Ziboleidi, son of the Wugu yilijin, alone did not rebel, and an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 是月，老人星見。

translations.literal: That month the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 上東幸，甲寅，以獲鴨，除鷹坊刺面、腰斬之刑，復其徭役。

translations.literal: The Emperor went east on a tour; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor traveled east; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.

sentences.zh: 是月，烏古殺其長窣離底，餘眾降，復叛。

translations.literal: That month the Wugu killed their chief Sulidi; the remainder surrendered and then rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Wugu killed their chief Sulidi; the survivors surrendered and then rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，近侍東兒進匕箸不時，手刃刺之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment and was stabbed to death by the Emperor's own hand.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment, and the Emperor stabbed him to death with his own blade.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大黃室韋酋長寅尼吉叛。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the great Yellow Shiwei chieftain Yinniji rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the great Yellow Shiwei chieftain Yinniji rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，五坊人四十戶叛入烏古。

translations.literal: On guiwei day forty households of Wufang people defected to the Wugu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day forty households of Wufang people defected to the Wugu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，虞人沙剌叠偵鵝失期，加炮烙、鐵梳之刑而死。

translations.literal: On guisi day the gamekeeper Shaladie missed his deadline while scouting geese; roasting-iron and iron-comb torture was added, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the gamekeeper Shaladie missed his deadline scouting geese; roasting-iron and iron-comb torture were added, and he died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，小黃室韋叛，雅裏斯、楚思等擊之，為室韋所敗，遣使詰之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi day, the lesser Yellow Shiwei rebelled; Yalisi, Chusi, and others attacked them but were defeated by the Shiwei, and envoys were sent to rebuke them.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on yisi day, the lesser Yellow Shiwei rebelled; Yalisi, Chusi, and others attacked them but were beaten by the Shiwei, and envoys were sent to rebuke them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以禿裏代雅裏斯為都統，以女古為監軍，率輕騎進討，仍令撻馬尋吉裏持詔招諭。

translations.literal: On yimao day Tulii replaced Yalisi as commander-in-chief, Nügu was made army supervisor, and light cavalry were led forward to suppress the rebels; tamada Xunjili was also ordered to carry an edict summoning and persuading them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Tulii replaced Yalisi as commander-in-chief, Nügu was made army supervisor, and light cavalry were sent to suppress the rebels; tamada Xunjili was also ordered to carry an edict summoning and persuading them to submit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，尋吉裏奏，諭之不從。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen day, Xunjili reported that persuasion had been refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen day, Xunjili reported that they refused to be persuaded.

sentences.zh: 雅裏斯以撻凜、蘇二群牧兵追至柴河，與戰不利。

translations.literal: Yalisi, with Tartar and Su herd-guard troops, pursued them to Chai River and fought without success.
translations.idiomatic: Yalisi, with Tartar and Su herd-guard troops, pursued them to Chai River and fought without success.

sentences.zh: 甲申，庫古只奏室韋長寅尼吉亡入敵烈。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Kuguzhi reported that Shiwei chief Yinniji had fled into Dilie territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Kuguzhi reported that Shiwei chief Yinniji had fled into Dilie territory.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，俞魯古獻良馬，賜銀二千兩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinhai day, Yulugu presented fine horses and was granted two thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinhai day, Yulugu presented fine horses and received two thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 以近侍忽剌比馬至先以聞，賜銀千兩。

translations.literal: Because the attendant Hulabi's horse had arrived first with the report, he was granted one thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Because the attendant Hulabi's horse had arrived first with the report, he received one thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 是月，敵烈來降。

translations.literal: That month the Dilie came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Dilie submitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，雅裏斯奏烏古至河德濼，遣夷離堇畫裏、夷離畢常思擊之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, Yalisi reported that the Wugu had reached Hedeb Marsh and dispatched yilijin Huali and yilibi Changsi to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on jiaxu day, Yalisi reported that the Wugu had reached Hedeb Marsh and dispatched yilijin Huali and yilibi Changsi to attack them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，烏古掠上京北榆林峪居民，遣林牙蕭斡討之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Wugu plundered residents of Yulin Valley north of the Supreme Capital, and linya Xiao Wo was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Wugu plundered residents of Yulin Valley north of the Supreme Capital, and linya Xiao Wo was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，雅裏斯等與烏古戰，不利。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Yalisi and the others fought the Wugu without success.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yalisi and his forces fought the Wugu without success.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，常思與烏古戰，敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei day, Changsi fought the Wugu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on dingwei day, Changsi fought the Wugu and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，以近侍喜哥私歸，殺其妻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, because the attendant Xige had returned home without permission, his wife was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, because the attendant Xige had returned home without permission, his wife was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁未，殺近侍隨魯。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the attendant Suilu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the attendant Suilu was killed.

sentences.zh: 駐蹕黑山平澱。

translations.literal: The court encamped at Black Mountain Pingdian.
translations.idiomatic: The court made its quarters at Black Mountain Pingdian.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月丁卯朔，被酒，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, he was drunk and declined congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor was drunk and refused congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，微行市中，賜酒家銀絹。

translations.literal: On jiashen day he walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，殺近侍白海及家仆衫福、押剌葛、樞密使門吏老古、撻馬失魯。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the attendant Baihai, the household servants Shanfu and Yalage, Palace Secretariat gate clerk Laogu, and tamada Shilu were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the attendant Baihai, the household servants Shanfu and Yalage, Palace Secretariat gate clerk Laogu, and tamada Shilu were put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，東幸。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jisi day, he went east on a tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi day, the Emperor traveled east.

sentences.zh: 庚午獲鴨，甲申獲鵝，皆飲達旦。

translations.literal: On gengwu day ducks were taken; on jiashen day geese were taken; on both occasions he drank until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day ducks were taken and on jiashen day geese were taken; on both occasions he drank until dawn.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，以歲旱，泛舟於池禱雨；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 不雨，舍舟立水中而禱，俄頃乃雨。

translations.literal: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，以白海死非其罪，賜其家銀絹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, because Baihai's death had been undeserved, his family was granted silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, because Baihai had been killed without cause, his family received silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，諭有司：凡行幸之所，必高立標識，令民勿犯，違以死論。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, officials were instructed: wherever the Emperor traveled, tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass; violators were to be sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on renwu day, officials were instructed that wherever the Emperor traveled tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass, on pain of death.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，漢遣使貢金器、鎧甲。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, Han sent envoys presenting gold vessels and armor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, Han sent envoys with gold vessels and armor.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，觀野鹿入馴鹿群，立馬飲至晡。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, he watched wild deer enter a herd of tame deer and drank on horseback until late afternoon.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, he watched wild deer enter a herd of tame deer and drank on horseback until late afternoon.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，以重九宴飲，夜以繼日，至壬子乃罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he held a Double Ninth feast and drank day and night without pause until renzi day before it ended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he held a Double Ninth feast and drank day and night without pause until renzi day before it ended.

sentences.zh: 己未，殺狼人裏。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the wolf-keeper Li was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the wolf-keeper Li was killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，漢主有母喪，遣使賻吊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and envoys were sent with condolence gifts.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and the Emperor sent envoys with condolence gifts.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，幸酒人拔剌哥家，復幸殿前都點檢耶律夷臘葛第，宴飲連日。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, he visited the wine-server Bilege's home, then visited Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yilage's residence and feasted for days on end.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, he visited the wine-server Bilege's home, then visited Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yilage's residence and feasted for days on end.

sentences.zh: 賜金盂、細錦及孕馬百匹，左右授官者甚眾。

translations.literal: He granted a gold basin, fine brocade, and one hundred pregnant mares; many attendants received offices.
translations.idiomatic: He granted a gold basin, fine brocade, and one hundred pregnant mares, and many attendants received offices.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Han sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Han sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕黑山平澱。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Black Mountain Pingdian.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black Mountain Pingdian.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月庚寅朔，林牙蕭斡、郎君耶律賢適討烏古還，帝執其手，賜卮酒，授賢適右皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and appointed him right Pishi xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and made him right Pishi xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 雅裏斯、楚思、霞裏三人賜醨酒以辱之。

translations.literal: Yalisi, Chusi, and Xiali were granted sour thin wine to humiliate them.
translations.idiomatic: Yalisi, Chusi, and Xiali were given sour thin wine to humiliate them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，夷離畢骨欲獻烏古俘。

translations.literal: On yimao day yilibi Guyü presented Wugu captives.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day yilibi Guyü presented Wugu captives.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，高勛奏宋將城益津關，請以偏師擾之，上從之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun memorialized that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun reported that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，殺鷹人敵魯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen day, the hawk-keeper Dilu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on wuchen day, the hawk-keeper Dilu was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，射柳祈雨，復以水沃群臣。

translations.literal: On bingzi day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain and again poured water over the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain and again drenched the ministers with water.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，殺鹿人劄葛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the deer-keeper Zhage was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the deer-keeper Zhage was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，北府宰相蕭海璃薨，輟朝，罷重五宴。

translations.literal: On renchen day Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Haili died; court was suspended and the Double Fifth feast was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Haili died; court was suspended and the Double Fifth feast was canceled.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，支解雉人壽哥、念古，殺鹿人四十四人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were put to death.

sentences.zh: 是夏，駐蹕潭。

translations.literal: That summer the court encamped at Tan.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the court made its quarters at Tan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛酉，生日，以政事令阿不底病亟，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, he declined congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the eighth month on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, the Emperor declined congratulations.

sentences.zh: 九月，自丙戌朔獵於黑山、赤山，至於月終。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, from the bingxu new moon, he hunted at Black Mountain and Red Mountain until the month ended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, from the bingxu new moon, he hunted at Black Mountain and Red Mountain until the month ended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，殺酒人粹你。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yichou day, the wine-server Cuini was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on yichou day, the wine-server Cuini was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，殺近侍廷壽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, the attendant Yanshou was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, the attendant Yanshou was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，殺豕人阿不劄、曷魯、朮裏者、涅裏括。

translations.literal: On renchen day the pig-keepers Abuzha, Helu, Zhulizhe, and Nielikuo were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the pig-keepers Abuzha, Helu, Zhulizhe, and Nielikuo were put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚子，司天臺奏月當食不虧，上以為祥，歡飲達旦。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and rejoiced in drink until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and drank in celebration until dawn.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，殺鹿人唐果、直哥、撒剌。

translations.literal: On renyin day the deer-keepers Tangguo, Zhige, and Sala were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the deer-keepers Tangguo, Zhige, and Sala were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，手殺饔人海裏，復臠之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the body.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the corpse.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕黑河平澱。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Black River Pingdian.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black River Pingdian.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月乙酉朔，宴於宮中，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己亥，觀燈於市。

translations.literal: On jihai day he viewed lanterns in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor viewed lanterns in the market.

sentences.zh: 以銀百兩市酒，命群臣亦市酒，縱飲三夕。

translations.literal: He spent one hundred taels of silver to buy wine, ordered the ministers to buy wine as well, and drank freely for three nights.
translations.idiomatic: He spent one hundred taels of silver to buy wine, ordered the ministers to buy wine as well, and drank freely for three nights.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，幸五坊使霞實裏家，宴飲達旦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao day, he visited Wufang Commissioner Xiashili's home and feasted until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, he visited Wufang Commissioner Xiashili's home and feasted until dawn.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申朔，如潢河。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jiashen new moon, he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the third month the Emperor went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，獲鴐鵝，祭天地。

translations.literal: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and heaven and earth were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 造大酒器，刻為鹿文，名曰「鹿甒」，貯酒以祭天。

translations.literal: A great wine vessel was made, carved with deer patterns, named the Deer Urn, and filled with wine to sacrifice to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: A great wine vessel was made, carved with deer patterns, named the Deer Urn, and filled with wine for the heaven sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，殺鶻人胡特魯、近侍化葛及監囚海裏，仍剉海裏之屍。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the falconer Hutelu, the attendant Huage, and the prison guard Haili were killed; Haili's corpse was then mutilated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the falconer Hutelu, the attendant Huage, and the prison guard Haili were put to death, and Haili's corpse was then mutilated.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑朔，殺彘人抄裏只。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou new moon, the pig-keeper Chaolizhi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the guichou new moon of the fourth month, the pig-keeper Chaolizhi was killed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔左右從班有材器幹局者，不次擢用；

translations.literal: On jisi day an edict ordered that attendants in the left and right retinues who showed talent, ability, and practical skill be promoted out of turn.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered that attendants in the left and right retinues who showed talent, ability, and practical skill be promoted without regard to seniority.

sentences.zh: 老耄者，增俸以休於家。

translations.literal: For the aged and infirm, increase salary so they may retire at home.
translations.idiomatic: Those who were old and enfeebled were granted higher stipends so they could withdraw and live at home.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，重五，以被酒，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, the Double Fifth festival — being drunk, he did not accept congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fifth month, the Double Fifth festival, he was already drunk and refused the customary congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，獲鵝於述古水，野飲終夜。

translations.literal: On renchen day he caught geese at the Shugu River and drank in the wild through the night.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he took geese at the Shugu River and caroused in the open country all night long.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，與政事令蕭排押、南京留守高勛、太師昭古、劉承訓等酣飲，連日夜。

translations.literal: On dingyou day he drank heavily with Affairs commissioner Xiao Paiya, Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun, Grand Preceptor Zhaogu, Liu Chengxun, and others, day and night without pause.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day he went on a binge with Affairs commissioner Xiao Paiya, Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun, Grand Preceptor Zhaogu, Liu Chengxun, and others, drinking day and night without letup.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，殺鹿人頗德、臈哥、陶瑰、劄不哥、蘇古涅、雛保、彌古特、敵答等。

translations.literal: On yihai day he killed the deer keepers Pode, Lage, Taogui, Zhabuge, Sugunie, Chubao, Migute, Dida, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he put to death the deer keepers Pode, Lage, Taogui, Zhabuge, Sugunie, Chubao, Migute, Dida, and others.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，殺彘人屯奴。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen day, he killed pig keeper Tunnu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the sixth month he killed pig keeper Tunnu.

sentences.zh: 己未，為殿前都點檢夷臘葛置神帳，曲赦京畿囚。

translations.literal: On jiwei day he set up a divine tent for Palace Front inspector Yilige and proclaimed a partial amnesty for prisoners in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day he erected a divine tent for Palace Front inspector Yilige and granted a limited amnesty to prisoners in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，撻烈於雕窠中得牝犬來進。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Tielie obtained a bitch from an eagle nest and presented her.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Tielie found a female dog in an eagle nest and brought her as tribute.

sentences.zh: 是夏，清暑瑽潭。

translations.literal: That summer he sought cool at Cangtan.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he took his summer quarters at Cangtan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，漢主承鈞殂，子繼元立，來告，遣使吊祭。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou day, Han's ruler Chengjun died and his son Jiyuan succeeded; Han sent word, and envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the seventh autumn month Han's ruler Liu Chengjun died and his son Liu Jiyuan succeeded; when Han reported the death, the court sent envoys to offer condolences and perform the mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，殺詳穩八剌、拽剌痕篤等四人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, he killed the four men xiangwen Balu, Zhuahen Du, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the ninth month he executed xiangwen Balu, Zhuahen Du, and two others.

sentences.zh: 己丑，登小山祭天地。

translations.literal: On jichou day he climbed a small hill and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day he ascended a small hill and offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，知宋欲襲河東，諭西南面都統、南院大王撻烈豫為之備。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, learning that Song intended to strike Hedong, he instructed Southwest military governor and Southern Court Great King Tielie to prepare in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, when he learned that Song planned to attack Hedong, he ordered Southwest military governor and Southern Court Great King Tielie to ready defenses in advance.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，獵熊，以喚鹿人鋪姑並掖庭戶賜夷臘葛。

translations.literal: On yihai day he hunted bear and granted deer-caller Pugu together with palace household servants to Yilige.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he hunted bear and gave deer-caller Pugu, together with palace household staff, to Yilige.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以夷臘葛兼政事令，仍以黑山東抹真之地數十里賜之，以女瑰為近侍，女直詳穩戛陌為本部夷離堇。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Yilige was additionally made Affairs commissioner; several tens of li of land at Mozhen east of Black Mountain were granted him; Nu Gui was made a personal attendant, and Jurchen xiangwen Gamo was made yilijin of his department.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Yilige was also appointed Affairs commissioner and granted several tens of li of land at Mozhen east of Black Mountain; Nu Gui became his personal attendant, and Jurchen xiangwen Gamo was made yilijin of his household.

sentences.zh: 是秋，獵於西京諸山。

translations.literal: That autumn he hunted on the mountains around the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he hunted in the hills around the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，宋圍太原，詔撻烈為兵馬總管，發諸道兵救之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinhai new moon, Song besieged Taiyuan; an edict made Tielie grand commander of army and horse and ordered troops from every circuit to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the xinhai new moon of the tenth month, Song besieged Taiyuan; Tielie was made grand commander of army and horse and troops from every circuit were mobilized to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，冬至，被酒，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, the winter solstice — being drunk, he did not accept congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the eleventh month, the winter solstice, he was drunk and again refused congratulations.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，殺酒人搭烈葛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, he killed wine steward Dalage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the twelfth month he killed wine steward Dalage.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕黑山東川。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Black Mountain East Stream.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black Mountain East Stream.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月乙卯朔，宴宮中，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and did not accept congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, he feasted in the palace and refused the customary congratulations.

sentences.zh: 己丑，立春，被酒，命殿前都點檢夷臘葛代行擊土牛禮。

translations.literal: On jichou day, at the Start of Spring, being drunk, he ordered Palace Front inspector Yilige to perform the striking-the-earth-ox ritual in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Start of Spring, too drunk to attend himself, he had Palace Front inspector Yilige perform the earth-ox ceremony in his place.

sentences.zh: 甲午，與群臣為葉格戲。

translations.literal: On jiawu day he played the yage game with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day he joined the ministers in the yage board game.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，醉中驟加左右官。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, while drunk, he suddenly promoted attendants on the left and right.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, in his cups, he abruptly raised the ranks of attendants on either side.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔太尉化哥曰：「朕醉中處事有乖，無得曲從。

translations.literal: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage, saying, "When I handle affairs while drunk and go astray, you must not simply comply.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage: "When I decide matters in drunkenness and go wrong, you must not simply defer to me.

sentences.zh: 酒解，可覆奏。

translations.literal: When the wine has cleared, you may resubmit your memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Once I am sober, you may submit the matter again.

sentences.zh: 」自立春飲至月終，不聽政。

translations.literal: " From the Start of Spring he drank until the month ended and did not attend to government.
translations.idiomatic: " From the Start of Spring he kept drinking until the month was out and did not govern.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，漢劉繼元嗣立，遣使乞封冊。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiayin day, Liu Jiyuan of Han succeeded to the throne and sent envoys requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the second month Liu Jiyuan succeeded in Han and sent envoys begging investiture and a patent of enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣韓知範冊為皇帝。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was dispatched to invest him as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was sent to invest him as emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，殺前導末及益剌，剉其屍，棄之。

translations.literal: On guihai day he killed the forward guides Mo and Yila, dismembered their corpses, and cast them away.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he killed the forward guides Mo and Yila, hacked apart their bodies, and abandoned them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，漢遣使進白麃。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Han sent envoys presenting white sable.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Han sent envoys with tribute of white sable.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如懷州，獵獲熊，歡飲方醉，馳還行宮。

translations.literal: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted and captured a bear, drank joyfully until drunk, and galloped back to the mobile palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted down a bear, drank himself merry until he was drunk, then galloped back to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 是夜，近侍小哥、盥人花哥、庖人辛古等六人反，帝遇弒，年三十九，廟號穆宗。

translations.literal: That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and six others in all rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: That night personal attendant Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rose in revolt; the Emperor was assassinated at thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.

sentences.zh: 後附葬懷陵。

translations.literal: Later he was attached in burial at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: He was later buried by attachment at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 重熙二十一年，謚曰孝安敬正皇帝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi his posthumous title was Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was posthumously titled Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：穆宗在位十八年，知女巫妖妄見誅，諭臣下濫刑切諫，非不明也。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Muzong reigned eighteen years; he knew the witch's sorcery was false and had her executed, and he admonished his ministers against excessive punishment — he was not unintelligent.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Muzong held the throne for eighteen years; he saw through the witch's fraud and had her killed, and he urgently warned his ministers against arbitrary punishments — he was not without understanding.

sentences.zh: 而荒耽於酒，畋獵無厭。

translations.literal: Yet he abandoned himself to wine and hunted without satiety.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he gave himself over to drink and hunted without end.

sentences.zh: 偵鵝失期，加炮烙鐵梳之刑；

translations.literal: When goose scouts missed their deadline he imposed branding-iron and iron-comb torture;
translations.idiomatic: If goose scouts failed to return on time he applied branding irons and iron combs;

sentences.zh: 獲鴨甚歡，除鷹坊刺面之令。

translations.literal: when he caught ducks he was greatly pleased and abolished the hawk-ward decree on facial tattooing.
translations.idiomatic: when he took ducks he was so delighted that he lifted the hawk-ward order for facial tattooing.

sentences.zh: 賞罰無章，朝政不視，而嗜殺不已。

translations.literal: Rewards and punishments had no fixed rule; he would not look to court affairs, yet he never ceased killing.
translations.idiomatic: Reward and punishment followed no consistent rule; he ignored the business of government, yet his appetite for bloodshed never slackened.

sentences.zh: 變起肘腋，宜哉！

translations.literal: That rebellion arose from those at his elbow — as it should!
translations.idiomatic: That the revolt sprang from men at his very side was only to be expected!
